summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  **No code has been changed.** I read through the watchlist and auth code end-to-end to ground this plan; findings below are from that read-only pass.  ### What I already checked (read-only) and found to be correct - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` — every route (list/create/read/update/delete/add-item/remove-item) filters by `watchlists.user_id`, and its own auth middleware requires a valid session cookie before setting `X-User-Id`. This matches the pattern used for portfolio routes. - `client/src/lib/api.ts` — the fetch wrapper send
